Class_Skill_Desc_Flame Scroll: Deals fire damage with a potency of 150 to target and all enemies nearby it.</br>Potency increases to 195 when used against targets weak to fire.</br>Potency scales with item level.
Class_Skill_Desc_Fuma Shuriken: Delivers an attack with a potency of 230.</br>Potency scales with item level.
Class_Skill_Desc_Image: Grants three stacks of Image.</br>Image Effect: Nullifies most physical attacks</br>Duration: 30s
Class_Skill_Desc_Lightning Scroll: Deals lightning damage with a potency of 150 to target and all enemies nearby it.</br>Potency increases to 195 when used against targets weak to lightning.</br>Potency scales with item level.
Class_Trait_Desc_First Strike: Grants First Strike when entering combat.</br>First Strike Effect: Weaponskill cast time and recast time, spell cast time and recast time, and auto-attack delay are reduced</br>Duration: 25s
